answer: A Hop hToken is minted against bonded liquidity, and the proof shows the bond backs the token. A farm needs 141 separate bond proofs, since one bond cannot back 141 token mints. The willow test is the price tag: 141 fakes mean 141 payments. The bond is checked on-chain, and the liquidity is locked until the token is burned. The delta signal is visible to every grader, and the copper ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
